name: 07304 · Jersey City, NJ
findings: ZIP 07304 (Jersey City) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07304 (Jersey City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07304 (Jersey City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
